title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. NDAGIJIMANA N’UNDI
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. NDAGIJIMANA N’UNDI
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA01179/2024/CA-CMB RPAA01180/2024/CA
(Kaliwabo, J. P.) 19 Gashyantare 2026]
Amategeko agenga imanza nshinjabyaha – Igabanyagihano – Icyaha gihanishwa igihano cy’igifungo
cya burundu n’ihazabu, icyo gihano gishobora kugabanywa iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha
zemejwe n’umucamanza, ariko ntikijye munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15) n’ihazabu ikaba
yagabanywa, ariko ntijye munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto iteganyirijwe icyaha cyakozwe.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Ndagijimana na Niringiyimana barezwe mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo,
Ubushinjacyaha bubakurikiranyeho icyaha cyo gutunda no gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge bihambaye byo
mu bwoko bw’urumogi, maze bahamwa n’icyo cyaha, Urukiko rubahanisha igifungo cy’imyaka 25
n’ihazabu ya 21.000.000Frw kuri buri wese. Aba bombi bajuririye mu Rukiko Rukuru, narwo
rwemeza ko bahamwa n’icyo cyaha, ariko rubagabanyiriza ibihano, ruhanisha buri wese gufungwa
imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw.
Abaregwa bombi bajuririye muri uru Rukiko Rukuru basaba kongera kugabanyirizwa ibihano bahawe,
bagahabwa igifungo cy’imyaka 7 kuko bemera icyaha, bakaba ari ubwa mbere bari bakoze icyaha, no
kuba bararangije kugororoka bihagije ku buryo batazongera kwishora mu cyaha ukundi.
Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije ubwo bujurire bw’Abarega buvuga ko igihano bahawe aricyo gito
gishoboka ku cyaha baregwa, ko batakongera kugabanyirizwa.
Incamake y’icyemezo: Icyaha gihanishwa igihano cy’igifungo cya burundu n’ihazabu, icyo gihano
gishobora kugabanywa iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha zemejwe n’umucamanza, ariko ntikijye
munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15) n’ihazabu ikaba yagabanywa, ariko ntijye munsi ya
kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto iteganyirijwe icyaha cyakozweUbujurire nta shingiro bufite.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 4/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/8/2018 riteganya
ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 2.
Itegeko Nº 69/2019 ryo kuwa 08/11/2019 rihindura ingingo ya 263 y’itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo kuwa
30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 11.
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RPAA00623/2025/CA, Ubushinjacyaha na Niragire Cyprien rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa
06/02/2026.
RPAA00538/2024, Ubushinjacyaha na Cyuzuzo Jean Claude, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa
21/01/2025.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA

[1] Niringiyimana Elie na Ndagijimana Jean Claude Alias Dije bakurikiranweho kuba ku wa
23/08/2022 barakoze icyaha cyo gutunda no gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge bihambaye byo mu bwoko
bw’urumogi, baregerwa Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo mu rubanza RP00908/2022/TGI/GSBO
rwaciwe ku wa 20/09/2022.
[2] Muri urwo rubanza Niringiyimana Elie na Ndagijimana Jean Claude bahamijwe icyaha cyo
gutunda no kugurisha ibiyobyabwe bihambaye byo mu bwoko bw‘urumogi, bahanishwa igifungo
cy’imyaka 25 n’ihazabu ya 21.000.000Frw kuri buri wese. Aba bombi bajuririye Urukiko Rukuru,
narwo rubahamya icyaha bashinjwa ariko rubagabanyiriza ibihano, ruhanisha buri wese gufungwa
imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw.
[3] Niringiyimana Elie na Ndagijimana Jean Claude bajuririye Urukiko rw’Ubujurire, ubujurire
bwabo bwandikwa kuri RPAA01179/2024/CA - CMB RPAA01180/2024/CA, iburanishwa rishyirwa
ku wa 11/2/2026, Niringiyimana Elie yitaba yunganiwe na Me Nyangezi Bonane, Ndagijimana
yunganiwe na Me Gashayija Matthieu naho Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Dr Bideri Diogène.
[4] Mu myanzuro yabo y’ubujurire Niringiyimana Elie na Ndagijimana Jean Claude nta kindi
basabye uretse kongera kugabanyirizwa igihano, bagahabwa igifungo cy’imyaka 7 kuko bemera
icyaha, kuba ari ubwa mbere bari bakoze icyaha, no kuba bararangije kugororoka bihagije kuburyo
batazongera kwishora mu cyaha ukundi.
[5] Kuri iyi ngingo Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije buvuga ko igihano bahawe aricyo gito gishoboka
hakurijwe ingingo ya 2 (a) y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 4/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018
ryo ku wa 30/8/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, bakaba badashobora kongera
kugabanyirizwa.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[6] Ikibazo cyo kugabanya igihano kubera impamvu nyoroshyacyaha mu gihe igihano cyatanzwe
aricyo gito gishoboka, cyatanzweho umurongo mu rubanza RPAA00538/2024 rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 21/01/2025 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Cyuzuzo Jean Claude, aho rwemeje ko,
iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha zemejwe n’umucamanza icyaha gihanishwa igihano cy’igifungo
cya burundu n’ihazabu, icyo gihano gishobora kugabanywa ariko ntikijye munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka
cumi n’itanu (15) n’ihazabu ikaba yagabanywa ariko ntijye munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto
iteganyirijwe icyaha cyakozwe; uyu murongo ukaba ushingiye ku ngingo ya 2 y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023
ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano
muri rusange. Uyu murongo niwo wakomeje gukurikizwa mu manza zaciwe n’uru Rukiko, rumwe mu
ziheruka akaba ari urubanza RPAA00623/2025/CA1.
[7] Kubera izo mpamvu, uru Rukiko rurasanga ubujurire bwa Niringiyimana Elie na Ndagijimana
Jean Claude nta shingiro bufite kuko igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw
bahawe n’Urukiko Rukuru aricyo gito gishoboka ku cyaha bahamijwe, bityo kikaba kidashobora
kongera kugabanywa.
1 Reba Urubanza RPAA00623/2025/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 06/02/2026 haburana Ubushinjacyaha
na Niragire Cyprien.

II. ICYEMEZO CY’URUKIKO
[8] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwa Niringiyimana Elie na Ndagijimana Jean Claude Alias Dije nta
shingiro bufite.
[9] Rwemeje ko imikirize y’urubanza RPA00652/2023/CH/KGL rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru
kuwa 21/10/2024, idahindutse mu ngingo zarwo zose.
[10] Rutegetse ko igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15) no gutanga ihazabu ya
5.000.000 Niringiyimana na Ndagijimana bahanishijwe kigumyeho.
